devices.description: List of block device paths to trace (e.g., ['/dev/sda', '/dev/nvme0n1']). Required at least one device unless using -I (not implemented here).

output_dir.description: Directory prefix for output files. Only valid with a single device or when using live mode (-o -).

output_basename.description: Base name for output files. Use '-' for live mode (piped to blkparse).

runtime_seconds.description: Run time in seconds. 0 means run indefinitely until killed.

buffer_size_kib.description: Buffer size per sub-buffer in KiB (default 512).

filter_masks.description: List of action filter masks (strings from: barrier, complete, discard, fs, issue, pc, queue, read, requeue, sync, write, notify, drv_data). Multiple masks allowed; combined via repeated -a.

hex_mask.description: Hexadecimal filter mask (e.g., '0x7fff'). Overrides -a masks when set. Must be version-specific.

listen_mode.description: If true, run blktrace in network listen mode (-l).

hostname.description: Hostname to connect to in network client mode (-h). Implies client mode if non-empty.

port.description: Network port to use in client or listen mode (default 8462).

not_sendfile.description: If true, disable sendfile() in network transfers (-s).
